note: Store-level comparability pin. Every constant that decides whether a capture is comparable at all lives HERE and not in each vector, so that re-stamping the corpus after a ratified amendment is one edit rather than N. Per-vector fields (dec1_revision, oracle.fineract_commit, oracle.threaded_mathcontext, oracle.ambient_mathcontext) are checked AGAINST this file, so a vector cannot quietly disagree with it.
